title: Shipping Team Leader (f/m/d)
description:
You lead the shipping team of our online shop.

What you'll do
- Lead 15 employees and plan shifts
- Secure shipping deadlines
- Work with customer service and returns handling

What you bring
- Experience in warehouse or shipping, leadership experience
- Confident English at B2 level is required, as we communicate with international shipping providers
- Knowledge of a merchandise management system
